blocks.zh: 第七節：人員
blocks.en: Section 7: Personnel

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解人員是無菌製程中首要污染源，掌握「最少人數原則」及其對無菌保證的重要性
blocks.en: Understand that personnel are the primary source of contamination in aseptic processing, and grasp the minimum-personnel principle and its importance for sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 熟悉各潔淨等級（Grade A/B vs C vs D）的更衣要求差異，以及無菌著裝確效 (Aseptic Gowning Qualification) 的程序與頻率
blocks.en: Know how gowning requirements differ by cleanroom grade (grade A/B vs C vs D), and the procedure and frequency of aseptic gowning qualification

blocks.zh: 瞭解人員健康管理、排除標準（脫落生物體 Shedding Organisms）與進入受限區域的規定
blocks.en: Understand the rules on personnel health, exclusion criteria (shedding organisms) and access to restricted areas

blocks.zh: 掌握人員在潔淨室的行為規範、服裝管理（清洗驗證、最大使用次數）及活性微生物監測要求
blocks.en: Grasp the rules on behaviour in the cleanroom, garment management (laundry validation, maximum number of uses) and viable microbial monitoring of personnel

blocks.zh: 本節核心原則 Core Principle of This Section
blocks.en: Core Principle of This Section

blocks.zh: 人員是無菌製程中最大的污染威脅。即使在最先進的隔離器 (Isolator) 技術下，人員仍透過操作、干預、設計決策等間接方式影響無菌保證。在 RABS（限制進出屏障系統）和開放式充填操作中，人員更是直接的污染風險來源。Section 7 的所有要求都圍繞這一核心原則展開：如何通過訓練、更衣、健康管理和行為規範，將人員污染風險最小化。
blocks.en: Personnel are the greatest contamination threat in aseptic processing. Even with the most advanced isolator technology, people still affect sterility assurance indirectly through their operations, interventions and design decisions. In RABS (restricted access barrier systems) and open filling operations, personnel are a direct source of contamination risk. Every requirement in Section 7 follows from this core principle: how to minimise the risk of contamination from personnel through training, gowning, health control and behavioural rules.

blocks.zh: 7.1–7.3 人員資格與訓練 Personnel Qualification & Training
blocks.en: 7.1–7.3 Personnel Qualification & Training

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 最少人數原則 (Minimum Personnel Principle)：每增加一個人，就增加一個污染源。人體每分鐘脫落約 10 萬個微粒，即使穿著無菌服裝，也無法完全阻隔。因此，Grade A/B 區的人員數量必須經過正式風險評估，在 APS（無菌製程模擬）時確認，並以文件規定最大人數。
blocks.en: Minimum personnel principle: every additional person is an additional source of contamination. A human body sheds roughly 100,000 particles per minute, and even sterile garments cannot block this completely. The number of personnel in grade A/B areas must therefore be justified by a formal risk assessment, confirmed during the APS (aseptic process simulation), and a maximum number set in a document.

blocks.zh: 訓練的三個層次：
blocks.en: Three levels of training:

blocks.zh: 基礎層：微生物學基礎、個人衛生（所有接觸潔淨室人員）
blocks.en: Basic level: basic microbiology and personal hygiene (everyone who accesses the cleanroom)

blocks.zh: 中階層：潔淨室行為、污染控制、更衣確效（Grade C/D 人員）
blocks.en: Intermediate level: cleanroom behaviour, contamination control and gowning qualification (grade C/D personnel)

blocks.zh: 高階層：無菌技術、APS 參與、患者安全意識（Grade A/B 人員）
blocks.en: Advanced level: aseptic technique, APS participation and patient safety awareness (grade A/B personnel)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 潔淨室的人員管理就像「手術室的外科團隊管理」——手術室只允許必要的外科醫生、麻醉師和護士進入，每個人都有嚴格的無菌培訓和認證，而且每個人進入都是一個風險決策。不允許額外人員「旁觀」，因為每個人都是潛在的污染源。PIC/S 7.2 的邏輯完全相同：潔淨室不是開放參觀的場所，每個進入者的資格與必要性都必須被審核。
blocks.en: Cleanroom personnel management is like managing a surgical team in an operating theatre. Only the necessary surgeons, anaesthetists and nurses may enter, each has strict aseptic training and certification, and every entry is a risk decision. No extra people are allowed to "watch", because every person is a potential source of contamination. PIC/S 7.2 follows exactly the same logic: a cleanroom is not open for visits, and the qualification and necessity of everyone who enters must be reviewed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 訓練必須告知操作員「若產品不無菌，對患者的潛在安全影響」——這是 PIC/S 2022 版新增強調的要點。理由是：當操作員理解自己的每一個動作可能影響患者生死，才能真正建立「無菌意識 (Aseptic Mindset)」，而不只是機械地遵從程序。
blocks.en: Training must tell operators about the potential impact on patient safety if a product is not sterile; this is a point newly emphasised in the 2022 revision of PIC/S Annex 1. The reasoning is that only when operators understand that each of their actions could affect a patient's life can a true "aseptic mindset" be built, rather than mechanical compliance with procedures.

blocks.zh: 清潔人員、維護人員、環境監測人員也必須接受相同的訓練和更衣確效——他們雖然不直接操作產品，但進入潔淨室本身就是污染風險。這一點在稽核中常被忽略。
blocks.en: Cleaning staff, maintenance staff and environmental monitoring staff must also receive the same training and gowning qualification. They do not handle product directly, but entering the cleanroom is itself a contamination risk. This point is often overlooked in audits.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的廠房 Grade B 充填間在 APS 期間最多允許幾個人？這個數字是如何決定的？若日常生產需要增加一名人員，需要什麼步驟才能合規？
blocks.en: What is the maximum number of people allowed in your site's grade B filling room during an APS? How was this number determined? If routine production needs one more person, what steps are needed to remain compliant?

blocks.zh: 一名新進清潔工需要進入 Grade C 區域工作。他需要完成哪些訓練和確效才能獲准進入？
blocks.en: A newly hired cleaner needs to work in a grade C area. What training and qualification must he complete before being allowed to enter?

blocks.zh: 7.4–7.6 無菌著裝確效與取消資格 Aseptic Gowning Qualification & Disqualification
blocks.en: 7.4–7.6 Aseptic Gowning Qualification & Disqualification

blocks.zh: 無菌著裝確效 (Aseptic Gowning Qualification)：評估操作員是否能正確穿著無菌服裝而不污染自身。評估包含兩個面向：
blocks.en: Aseptic gowning qualification: evaluates whether an operator can put on sterile garments correctly without contaminating themselves. The evaluation has two aspects:

blocks.zh: 目視評估 (Visual Assessment)：觀察更衣程序是否符合 SOP（順序、手套消毒時機、是否觸碰外表面）
blocks.en: Visual assessment: observe whether the gowning procedure follows the SOP (sequence, timing of glove disinfection, whether outer surfaces are touched)

blocks.zh: 微生物評估 (Microbial Assessment)：更衣完成後，在戴手套的手指、前臂、胸部、頭套等位置取樣，確認微生物計數符合 9.30 節規定的限度
blocks.en: Microbial assessment: after gowning, sample the gloved fingers, forearms, chest, hood and similar locations, and confirm that microbial counts meet the limits in clause 9.30

blocks.zh: 進入 Grade A/B 的雙重資格要求：必須同時滿足「通過更衣評估」AND「參與並通過 APS」兩個條件，才能獲准無監督進入。兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: Dual qualification requirement for entry to grade A/B: both conditions, "passing the gowning assessment" AND "participating in and passing an APS", must be met before unsupervised access is permitted. Neither alone is sufficient.

blocks.zh: 更衣確效就像「外科手術刷手的資格認證」——不是每個醫學院學生都能自動進入手術室，必須通過手術刷手的正確性評估（目視）和培養結果確認（微生物）。一旦發現刷手不合格（或術後培養異常），必須重新訓練後才能再次進入手術室。APS（無菌製程模擬）的要求類似外科住院醫師的「第一次獨立手術」——必須在監督下成功完成後，才能獲得獨立執刀資格。
blocks.en: Gowning qualification is like certifying a surgeon's scrub technique. Not every medical student can automatically enter the operating theatre; they must pass an assessment of correct scrubbing (visual) and have culture results confirmed (microbial). If the scrub is found to be unacceptable (or post-operative cultures are abnormal), retraining is required before re-entering the theatre. The APS (aseptic process simulation) requirement is similar to a surgical resident's "first independent operation": it must be completed successfully under supervision before independent operating rights are granted.

blocks.zh: 取消資格 (Disqualification) 制度的三個觸發條件：
blocks.en: Three triggers for the disqualification system:

blocks.zh: 持續評估中發現問題（如目視評估多次不通過）
blocks.en: Problems found during ongoing assessment (for example, repeated failures of the visual assessment)

blocks.zh: 人員監測計畫中發現不良趨勢（如個人更衣後微生物計數持續偏高）
blocks.en: Adverse trends found in the personnel monitoring programme (for example, persistently high microbial counts after an individual's gowning)

blocks.zh: 被牽涉於失敗的 APS（即使不是主要操作者，參與本身也可能觸發重新評估）
blocks.en: Involvement in a failed APS (even if not the main operator, participation itself may trigger reassessment)

blocks.zh: 取消資格後必須完成再訓練 AND 再確效。對於 Grade B/A 人員，再確效需考慮參與一次成功的 APS——這意味著重新獲得資格的過程可能需要數週。CDMO 必須確保有足夠的「備援合格人員」，以避免生產瓶頸。
blocks.en: After disqualification, both retraining AND requalification must be completed. For grade B/A personnel, requalification should include participation in one successful APS, which means regaining qualification may take several weeks. A CDMO must ensure there are enough "backup qualified personnel" to avoid production bottlenecks.

blocks.zh: 更衣確效頻率要求
blocks.en: Gowning Qualification Frequency Requirements

blocks.zh:
更衣確效週期：
  Grade A/B 人員：至少每年一次 (annually)
  新進人員：初始確效 → 通過後才能獨立進入
  失敗或 APS 失敗後：立即取消資格 → 再訓練 → 再確效

更衣微生物評估取樣位置（7.4 指定）：
  - 戴手套的手指 (gloved fingers)
  - 前臂 (forearms)
  - 胸部 (chest)
  - 頭套/面罩/前額 (hood/facemask/forehead)

參考限度：見 PIC/S Annex 1 第 9.30 節
（表格規定 Grade A/B 更衣後人員監測限度）
blocks.en:
Gowning qualification cycle:
  Grade A/B personnel: at least once a year (annually)
  New personnel: initial qualification → independent entry only after passing
  After a failure or APS failure: immediate disqualification → retraining → requalification

Sampling locations for gowning microbial assessment (specified in 7.4):
  - Gloved fingers
  - Forearms
  - Chest
  - Hood/facemask/forehead

Reference limits: see PIC/S Annex 1 clause 9.30
(the table specifies personnel monitoring limits after gowning for grade A/B)

blocks.zh: 一名有 5 年經驗的資深操作員今年的更衣微生物評估顯示前臂計數超過 9.30 節的限度。應採取哪些步驟？他能否繼續進行已排程的生產？
blocks.en: A senior operator with 5 years of experience has a forearm count above the clause 9.30 limit in this year's gowning microbial assessment. What steps should be taken? Can he continue with scheduled production?

blocks.zh: 一名工程師需要在 APS 進行期間進入 Grade B 區域進行緊急設備調整，但他未完成更衣確效。請描述合規的處理程序。
blocks.en: An engineer needs to enter the grade B area for an urgent equipment adjustment during an APS, but he has not completed gowning qualification. Describe the compliant handling procedure.

blocks.zh: 7.7–7.9 健康管理與個人衛生 Health Monitoring & Personal Hygiene
blocks.en: 7.7–7.9 Health Monitoring & Personal Hygiene

blocks.zh: 脫落生物體 (Shedding Organisms)：人體持續脫落皮膚細胞、毛髮、呼吸道分泌物等，這些攜帶微生物的顆粒是潔淨室中微生物污染的主要來源。以下健康狀況會顯著增加脫落量：
blocks.en: Shedding organisms: the human body continuously sheds skin cells, hair, respiratory secretions and similar material, and these microbe-carrying particles are the main source of microbial contamination in cleanrooms. The following health conditions significantly increase shedding:

blocks.zh: 皮膚疾病（濕疹、牛皮癬、傷口）
blocks.en: Skin conditions (eczema, psoriasis, wounds)

blocks.zh: 上呼吸道感染（感冒、鼻竇炎）
blocks.en: Upper respiratory tract infections (colds, sinusitis)

blocks.zh: 腸胃道感染（沙門氏菌、諾羅病毒）
blocks.en: Gastrointestinal infections (Salmonella, norovirus)

blocks.zh: 近期接觸動物組織或微生物培養物
blocks.en: Recent contact with animal tissue or microbial cultures

blocks.zh: 員工有義務「主動回報」上述狀況——這必須成為企業文化的一部分，而非員工擔心請假被扣薪而隱瞞。
blocks.en: Employees have an obligation to "proactively report" the above conditions. This must become part of the company culture, rather than employees concealing illness for fear of losing pay for sick leave.

blocks.zh: 個人健康管理就像「廚師的食品安全健康規定」——患有腸胃道感染的廚師不能上崗，因為他的手、呼吸、甚至汗水都可能污染食物。製藥廠的無菌操作員也一樣：感冒的操作員打個噴嚏，哪怕戴著口罩，噴出的氣溶膠微粒仍可能穿越防護，污染臨近的開口容器。這不是苛求，是對使用者安全的基本保障。
blocks.en: Personal health control is like the health rules for food safety among chefs. A chef with a gastrointestinal infection cannot work, because his hands, breath and even sweat could contaminate the food. The same applies to aseptic operators in a pharmaceutical plant: if an operator with a cold sneezes, even while wearing a mask, the aerosol particles expelled may still get through the protection and contaminate nearby open containers. This is not excessive; it is a basic safeguard for user safety.

blocks.zh: 7.8 的跨污染風險：在研發中心或多功能廠房中，同一名操作員可能上午在微生物實驗室培養菌株，下午進入無菌充填區——這是絕對禁止的。必須有明確的「去污染與進入程序 (decontamination and entry procedures)」，且必須文件記錄。
blocks.en: Cross-contamination risk in 7.8: in an R&D centre or multi-purpose facility, the same operator might culture strains in the microbiology laboratory in the morning and enter the aseptic filling area in the afternoon. This is strictly prohibited. Clear "decontamination and entry procedures" must exist and be documented.

blocks.zh: 7.9 廠商供應的電子設備：智慧型手機、平板電腦在現代製造中越來越普遍，但必須滿足：(1) 廠商供應（非個人設備）；(2) 設計允許清潔消毒；(3) 納入 CCS。個人手機是絕對禁止的，因為無法確保消毒的有效性。
blocks.en: 7.9 Electronic devices supplied by the company: smartphones and tablets are increasingly common in modern manufacturing, but they must meet these conditions: (1) supplied by the company (not personal devices); (2) designed so that they can be cleaned and disinfected; (3) included in the CCS. Personal mobile phones are strictly prohibited because the effectiveness of disinfection cannot be assured.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 人員管理實務中，建立一個「健康回報系統」至關重要，同時需要配套的支持措施：例如患病員工有支薪病假（避免因擔心收入而帶病上班），以及明確的回報流程（向誰回報、回報後如何安排）。此外，對於接觸動物組織或細菌培養物的研發人員，需要建立「工作隔離時間表」，規定在接觸後需要等待多長時間（或完成哪些去污程序）才能進入潔淨區。
blocks.en: In CDMO personnel management, establishing a "health reporting system" is essential, together with supporting measures: for example, paid sick leave for ill employees (so that they do not work while sick for fear of losing income) and a clear reporting process (to whom to report, and how work is arranged after reporting). In addition, for R&D staff who handle animal tissue or bacterial cultures, a "work segregation schedule" should be set up, specifying how long they must wait (or which decontamination procedures they must complete) after such contact before entering the cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 一名操作員早晨在 QC 實驗室進行了沙門氏菌標準品的操作，下午被分配去 Grade C 區協助清潔工作。你作為班組長應如何處理？
blocks.en: One morning an operator handled Salmonella reference standards in the QC laboratory, and in the afternoon he is assigned to assist with cleaning in a grade C area. As shift leader, how would you handle this?

blocks.zh: 管理層考慮在 Grade B 更衣室安裝廠商提供的平板電腦，用於即時查閱 SOP。這需要在 CCS 中增加哪些內容？
blocks.en: Management is considering installing company-supplied tablets in the grade B gowning room for real-time access to SOPs. What needs to be added to the CCS?

blocks.zh: 7.10–7.13 各等級更衣要求 Gowning Requirements by Cleanroom Grade
blocks.en: 7.10–7.13 Gowning Requirements by Cleanroom Grade

blocks.zh: Grade B 的全套無菌更衣就像「太空衣」——每一個縫隙都必須密封，任何暴露的皮膚都是潛在的污染入口。護目鏡不只是眼部保護——它封閉了臉部皮膚暴露的最後一個區域（眼睛周圍）。雙層手套的設計也很精妙：穿衣時戴第一層（用來觸碰已消毒的無菌衣包裝），穿衣完成後再戴第二層（確保接觸產品環境的手套是在完全無菌條件下穿戴的）。每一個設計細節都是為了阻斷污染路徑。
blocks.en: The full aseptic gowning for grade B is like a "space suit": every gap must be sealed, and any exposed skin is a potential entry point for contamination. Goggles are not just eye protection; they close off the last area of exposed facial skin (around the eyes). The double-glove design is also clever: the first pair is put on when gowning (used to handle the sterilised garment packaging), and the second pair is put on after gowning is complete (so that the gloves in contact with the product environment are donned under fully aseptic conditions). Every design detail serves to block a contamination path.

blocks.zh: 服裝目視檢查（7.11）的三個時間點：
blocks.en: Three points in time for visual garment inspection (7.11):

blocks.zh: 穿著前：檢查清潔度和完整性（確保包裝未破損、服裝無破洞）
blocks.en: Before donning: check cleanliness and integrity (make sure the packaging is intact and the garment has no holes)

blocks.zh: 穿著後：確認穿著正確（所有縫隙封閉、袖口收進手套）
blocks.en: After donning: confirm correct wearing (all gaps closed, cuffs tucked into gloves)

blocks.zh: 脫除時：再次檢查完整性（損壞的服裝可能代表穿著過程中的完整性失效，需調查是否影響當班的無菌操作）
blocks.en: At removal: check integrity again (damaged garments may indicate an integrity failure during wear, and an investigation is needed into whether aseptic operations during that shift were affected)

blocks.zh: 服裝保質期 (Hold Time) 管理：已滅菌服裝有有效期限（由確效研究決定）。使用前必須確認服裝仍在保質期內，過期未使用的服裝必須退回重新滅菌。這在日常管理中容易被疏漏，是稽核常見發現項目。
blocks.en: Garment hold time management: sterilised garments have an expiry period (determined by validation studies). Before use, confirm the garment is still within its hold time; expired unused garments must be returned for re-sterilisation. This is easily overlooked in daily management and is a common audit finding.

blocks.zh: 服裝確效 (Garment Qualification) 是 CDMO 廠房啟用前的重要項目，通常包含：粒子脫落測試（ISO 9073 或等效）、粒子截留測試、清洗耐用性測試（評估最大清洗次數後的性能）。CDMO 選擇服裝供應商時，除了價格，還必須考慮供應商是否能提供完整的確效支持資料（Certificate of Compliance、粒子測試報告）。若服裝品質不達標，每一次更衣都是一次潛在的污染事件。
blocks.en: Garment qualification is an important item before a CDMO facility is commissioned, and usually includes particle shedding tests (ISO 9073 or equivalent), particle retention tests, and laundering durability tests (evaluating performance after the maximum number of washes). When selecting a garment supplier, a CDMO must consider not only price but also whether the supplier can provide complete qualification support data (Certificate of Compliance, particle test reports). If garment quality is not up to standard, every gowning event is a potential contamination event.

blocks.zh: 操作員進入 Grade B 更衣間時發現無菌服裝的包裝有一個小孔洞。應如何處理？若他已穿上後才發現袖口有破洞，應採取什麼步驟？
blocks.en: An operator entering the grade B gowning room finds a small hole in the packaging of the sterile garment. How should this be handled? If he only notices a tear in the cuff after putting the garment on, what steps should be taken?

blocks.zh: Grade C 區的操作員被要求協助搬運已滅菌的充填零件（間接接觸零件）。依據 CCS，他是否需要在 Grade C 的標準更衣基礎上額外添加手套？判斷依據是什麼？
blocks.en: A grade C operator is asked to help carry sterilised filling parts (indirect product contact parts). According to the CCS, does he need to wear gloves in addition to the standard grade C gowning? What is the basis for the decision?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 各等級更衣要求對照
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Gowning Requirements by Grade

blocks.zh: 四個等級的更衣要求從嚴格到基本遞減：
blocks.en: The gowning requirements of the four grades decrease from the most stringent to the basic:

blocks.zh: 7.14–7.18 更衣室管理、服裝清洗與無菌行為 Gowning Rooms, Laundry & Aseptic Behaviour
blocks.en: 7.14–7.18 Gowning Rooms, Laundry & Aseptic Behaviour

blocks.zh: 更衣室的等級鏈 (Cascade of Gowning Rooms)：更衣必須在一個「足夠潔淨等級的更衣室」進行。若在污染的環境中穿無菌衣，無菌衣的外表面立刻被環境微粒污染。典型的更衣鏈：
blocks.en: Cascade of gowning rooms: gowning must take place in a gowning room of sufficiently clean grade. If sterile garments are put on in a contaminated environment, their outer surfaces are immediately contaminated by environmental particles. A typical gowning cascade:

blocks.zh: 室外服 → Grade D 更衣室（換廠服）
blocks.en: Outdoor clothing → grade D gowning room (change into factory clothing)

blocks.zh: 廠服 → Grade C 更衣室（換 Grade C 作業服）
blocks.en: Factory clothing → grade C gowning room (change into grade C work garments)

blocks.zh: Grade C 作業服 → Grade B 更衣室（換無菌全套服裝）
blocks.en: Grade C work garments → grade B gowning room (change into full sterile garments)

blocks.zh: 服裝最大穿著時間：由確效研究決定，通常為一個班次（8-12小時）或更短。超過最大穿著時間必須更換，這是防止服裝內部積累微生物的重要管控點。
blocks.en: Maximum garment wearing time: determined by validation studies, usually one shift (8-12 hours) or less. Garments must be changed after the maximum wearing time is exceeded, which is an important control point to prevent microbial build-up inside the garment.

blocks.zh: 無菌操作的行為規範就像「茶道的動作美學」——每個動作都要緩慢、有意識、有控制。快速移動會產生湍流，打亂 Grade A 區精心設計的單向氣流，讓來自低潔淨區的空氣「捲入」關鍵區域。這不只是規矩，而是有明確的氣流物理學基礎：氣流可視化研究 (Airflow Visualisation Study) 用煙霧試驗 (smoke study) 實際展示人員動作如何影響氣流路徑——這正是 7.18 要求將氣流可視化研究納入培訓計畫的原因。
blocks.en: Aseptic behaviour is like the movement aesthetics of the tea ceremony: every movement must be slow, deliberate and controlled. Rapid movement creates turbulence that disrupts the carefully designed unidirectional airflow in the grade A area and draws air from lower-grade areas into the critical zone. This is not just a rule; it has a clear basis in airflow physics. An airflow visualisation study uses a smoke study to show how personnel movements affect the airflow path, which is exactly why 7.18 requires airflow visualisation studies to be included in the training programme.

blocks.zh: 手套定期消毒（7.16）：手套的定期消毒（通常每 30 分鐘或每次觸碰非無菌表面後）是無菌操作的基本要求，必須在 SOP 中明確規定頻率和方式（IPA 噴霧或浸泡）。
blocks.en: Periodic glove disinfection (7.16): periodic disinfection of gloves (usually every 30 minutes or after each touch of a non-sterile surface) is a basic requirement of aseptic operations. The frequency and method (IPA spray or immersion) must be clearly specified in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 服裝清洗管理的四個合規要點（7.17）：
blocks.en: Four compliance points for garment laundry management (7.17):

blocks.zh: 清洗設施必須與生產操作充分隔離（防止交叉污染）
blocks.en: The laundry facility must be adequately segregated from production operations (to prevent cross-contamination)

blocks.zh: 清洗程序必須經過確效（確保不損壞服裝纖維、不引入污染）
blocks.en: Laundry procedures must be validated (to ensure that garment fibres are not damaged and no contamination is introduced)

blocks.zh: 清洗後目視檢查（損壞的服裝需丟棄）
blocks.en: Visual inspection after laundering (damaged garments are discarded)

blocks.zh: 規定最大清洗與滅菌次數（超過限制的服裝必須報廢）
blocks.en: Maximum numbers of wash and sterilisation cycles are specified (garments exceeding the limits must be scrapped)

blocks.zh: 第一氣流 (First Air) 概念：從 HEPA 過濾器出來的最純淨氣流，稱為「First Air」。任何物體（人員、設備、手臂）橫越 First Air 的路徑，都可能在關鍵區域產生微渦流，讓攜帶微生物的氣溶膠進入。操作員必須學會「讓 First Air 不受阻礙地到達臨界表面」。
blocks.en: The concept of first air: the cleanest air leaving the HEPA filter is called "first air". Any object (personnel, equipment, an arm) crossing the path of first air may create micro-eddies in the critical zone and let microbe-carrying aerosols in. Operators must learn to "let first air reach critical surfaces unobstructed".

blocks.zh: 服裝生命週期管理框架
blocks.en: Garment Lifecycle Management Framework

blocks.zh:
服裝確效程序（典型）：
  初始確效：
    - 粒子脫落測試（新品）
    - 粒子截留測試（新品）
  使用週期確效：
    - 清洗 N 次後重複粒子測試
    - 滅菌 M 次後重複粒子測試
    - 視覺完整性評估

管理限制（由確效決定）：
  最大清洗次數 = N 次（超過即報廢）
  最大滅菌次數 = M 次（超過即報廢）
  最大連續穿著時間 = T 小時（超過即更換）
  滅菌後最大保質期 = X 週（超過即重滅菌）

CDMO 服裝管理挑戰：
  多人共用服裝 → 需個人編號追蹤使用次數
  客戶稽核時服裝清洗記錄常被查核
blocks.en:
Garment qualification procedure (typical):
  Initial qualification:
    - Particle shedding test (new garments)
    - Particle retention test (new garments)
  In-use cycle qualification:
    - Repeat particle test after N washes
    - Repeat particle test after M sterilisations
    - Visual integrity assessment

Management limits (determined by qualification):
  Maximum number of washes = N (scrap when exceeded)
  Maximum number of sterilisations = M (scrap when exceeded)
  Maximum continuous wearing time = T hours (change when exceeded)
  Maximum hold time after sterilisation = X weeks (re-sterilise when exceeded)

CDMO garment management challenges:
  Garments shared by multiple people → individual numbering needed to track number of uses
  Garment laundry records are often examined during customer audits

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實務中，氣流可視化研究 (Smoke Study) 的結果應納入操作員培訓計畫，讓操作員直觀看到自己的「錯誤動作」如何影響 Grade A 氣流。許多 CDMO 會在培訓影片中加入煙霧試驗片段：操作員快速橫越充填區時，Grade A 的 HEPA 氣流立刻被打亂，煙霧（代表污染微粒）被捲入容器開口上方——這比任何文字說明都更有說服力，能有效建立操作員的「無菌意識」。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, the results of airflow visualisation studies (smoke studies) should be built into the operator training programme, so that operators can see for themselves how their own "wrong movements" affect grade A airflow. Many CDMOs include smoke study footage in training videos: when an operator moves quickly across the filling area, the grade A HEPA airflow is immediately disrupted, and smoke (representing contaminating particles) is drawn in above the container openings. This is more persuasive than any written explanation and effectively builds the operator's "aseptic mindset".

blocks.zh: 一個班次進行到一半，Grade B 充填間的操作員意識到自己的無菌手套外層破了一個小孔。應立即採取哪些步驟？這對正在充填的這一批次有何影響？
blocks.en: Halfway through a shift, an operator in the grade B filling room realises that the outer layer of his sterile gloves has a small hole. What steps should be taken immediately? What is the impact on the batch being filled?

blocks.zh: 你的廠房 Grade B 服裝清洗合約由外部供應商負責。請列出在供應商稽核時你應查核的關鍵文件和程序。
blocks.en: Your site's grade B garment laundry is contracted to an external supplier. List the key documents and procedures you should check during a supplier audit.

blocks.zh: 為什麼操作員不能在充填操作進行時，橫越充填機前方的 Grade A 區域取物？從氣流物理學角度解釋這個禁止行為的理由。
blocks.en: Why must an operator not reach across the grade A area in front of the filling machine to fetch items while filling is in progress? Explain the reason for this prohibition from the standpoint of airflow physics.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 人員是無菌製程首要污染源。Grade A/B 區必須維持最少人數，並在 APS 時確認並文件化最大人數上限。所有接觸潔淨室的人員（含清潔、維護、監測人員）均須定期訓練，並了解無菌失敗對患者安全的影響。
blocks.en: Personnel are the primary source of contamination in aseptic processing. Grade A/B areas must keep personnel numbers to a minimum, with the maximum number confirmed and documented during the APS. All personnel who access the cleanroom (including cleaning, maintenance and monitoring staff) must be trained regularly and understand the impact of sterility failure on patient safety.

blocks.zh: Grade A/B 人員必須通過無菌著裝確效（目視+微生物評估），且至少每年重新評估；需同時參與成功的 APS，才能獲准無監督進入。出現不良趨勢或牽涉 APS 失敗者，應立即取消資格，完成再訓練與再確效後方可恢復。
blocks.en: Grade A/B personnel must pass aseptic gowning qualification (visual + microbial assessment) and be reassessed at least annually, and must also participate in a successful APS before being allowed unsupervised access. Those with adverse trends or involvement in a failed APS should be disqualified immediately and may be reinstated only after retraining and requalification.

blocks.zh: 健康管理：操作員有義務回報可能增加脫落風險的健康狀況；接觸過微生物培養物或動物組織者須完成文件化去污程序；個人手錶、飾物、個人手機禁止進入潔淨區。
blocks.en: Health control: operators are obliged to report health conditions that may increase shedding risk; those who have handled microbial cultures or animal tissue must complete a documented decontamination procedure; personal watches, jewellery and personal mobile phones are prohibited in cleanroom areas.

blocks.zh: 各等級更衣要求遞增：Grade B 須全套無菌服裝（護目鏡、口罩、雙層手套、無菌靴套）；Grade C 為高領袖口收緊連體服；Grade D 為一般防護服。服裝須視覺檢查、遵守保質期，定期清洗（確效程序），並設定最大清洗與滅菌次數。手套需定期消毒，操作時動作應緩慢有序，避免阻擋 Grade A 的單向氣流（First Air）。
blocks.en: Gowning requirements increase with grade: grade B requires full sterile garments (goggles, mask, double gloves, sterile boot covers); grade C requires a one-piece or two-piece suit with high neck and tightened cuffs; grade D requires general protective clothing. Garments must be visually inspected, used within hold times, and laundered under a validated procedure, with maximum wash and sterilisation cycles set. Gloves must be disinfected periodically, and movements should be slow and orderly so as not to obstruct the unidirectional airflow (first air) in grade A.
